A new update is coming to Orcs Must Die! 3 –
Crossplay between Steam and Epic Games Store players.
OMD!3 EGS/Steam Patch Live: May 2, at 10:00 AM CST
Orcs Must Die! 3 will be free to download between May 2 until May 9 on Epic Games Store.
Update 1.2.5.1
Miscellaneous crashes have been addressed and fixed.
Crossplay is active between Steam and Epic players and works for hosting and joining lobby games.
Steam and Epic players can also link their accounts. This enables friend invites via platform overlays. This is optional for players who wish to play with friends across Steam and EGS!
To link your account, go to "options" and click "yes" for "link external accounts".
This will require a restarting of the game, at which point you can follow the onscreen instructions from the account you are linking.
Fixes a crash associated with stacking status effects.
Greetings, War Mages!

This patch is focused on addressing the most common player feedback we receive. We’ve read concerns about trap damage versus player damage, and this balance pass allows players to get more traps into the battle.

We’ve also noticed some scenarios were trending too difficult in Rift Lord difficulty level and in certain Endless maps. We’ve made those fights a little fairer for the player. We hope to see improved scores and skull rewards in these areas.
Finally, we’ve added three maps to Endless mode, and we’ve fixed a host of rare but annoying crashes.
Please see the detailed patch notes below. Thanks for playing! We’ll be reading your feedback.
Robot Entertainment

Patch 1.1.1.0

We're bringing in the new year with Patch 1.1.1.0! This includes a new games list, two new endless maps, a new Evil Vorwick skin and a slew of improvements and bug fixes. The new games list is accessible from the mode select screen and will display hosted games across all campaigns, weekly challenges, and Endless mode.

This update was a quick turnaround from the larger September patch. We wanted to get a few quality of life improvements into the build, along with the two Endless map additions. The team is working hard on the Cold as Eyes DLC and we'll have more details soon.
Highlights
Hidden Dock and Masters Courtyard can now be played in Endless mode.
Enemy drops (Potions, Skulls, and Coins) now spawn to the nearest pathable location.
PC players can now set their preferred FPS cap or disable it.
Other Improvements

The primary goal over the last few weeks has been to identify and fix crashes and coop disconnects. A couple of weeks ago, we patched in a crash reporting tool. With this integration, we have data on the frequency of crashes, along with the associated crash logs. The most frequently occurring crash was related to friend invites. This along with four other crashes were fixed and included in this patch.
Highlights
Fixed multiple crash and disconnect issues.
Egan and Cygnus no longer get stuck when using abilities
Endless Leaderboards will be wiped

Today we've deployed a Steam update for Orcs Must Die 3 in order to address some early bugs and balance issues. We've gotten a lot of excellent feedback from Warmages in the community since the game's PC & console launch last month, and several fixes/changes are being made as a direct result of talking with players on social media, Steam forums, Reddit, and Discord. We hope this will address many of the concerns out there, but we realize there are some things yet to be addressed. We appreciate your patience as we continue working to make OMD3 the best orc-slaughtering game in the series.
Bug Fixes
Fixed issue where Saw blades would get stuck in enemy units and do constant damage over a short period of time.
Fixed an issue where the client in a coop game would start seeing the wisps and countdown before the previous wave finished.
Bug fixed with enemy speed increase effects not being applied in some places. This would include enemies rift rushing when the player dies, and Ogres charging.

Scramble: Losing a scenario no longer adds the scenario score to the Total Score

notes.title: 中文版重翻工作已完成

items.text: 各位游玩《兽人必须死3》中文版的玩家，你们好，我们已经重翻了游戏的中文版内容。
游戏的初版翻译质量非常糟糕，我们为此向所有玩家致以诚挚的歉意。我们已与两家翻译机构合作，重翻、润色了中文版的翻译。我们希望新版本的翻译质量会比之前有较大改进。
Hello all Orcs Must Die 3 players playing the game in Chinese. We have a new translation of the game ready.

We would like to apologize to every one of you for the game’s initial poor Chinese translation. We have worked with two different translation services to prepare an improved Chinese translation. We hope this version is much improved.
Key Re-Binding 1.0 is Here

Keybinding now supports movement and loadout key assignments! There are still a few tweaks we need to make to this, but we want to get this version 1.0 improvement out as soon as possible. We’re reading your feedback and working hard to fix bugs and polish things up. Thanks for playing!

New Chinese Translation Ready
Hello all Orcs Must Die 3 players playing the game in Chinese. We have a new translation of the game ready.

We would like to apologize to every one of you for the game’s initial poor Chinese translation. We have worked with two different translation services to prepare an improved Chinese translation. We hope this version is much improved.

We're issuing a hotfix that disables HDR while we work to implement a long-term solution. We hope this will help most players. We are watching your feedback closely and working on other issues you may be experiencing. We're working hard so that you can have the best experience possible.
